supportedSourceKinds.currentBoundary: Small caller-approved CSV and JSON files are supported only through the checked local source-builder fixture path.
Manual confirmation can turn proposed mappings into source-intake inputs in checked fixtures.
Manual upload setup can be represented by the workflow, but no generic upload intake runtime is implemented.
Policy-bound fixture replay is implemented; production live auto-evidence gathering is not.
Private API setup can be represented by the workflow, but no generic API connector runtime is implemented.
Private database setup can be represented by the workflow, but no generic database connector runtime is implemented.

phases.purpose: Inspect or declare caller-approved sources before creating source manifests or mappings.
phases.guardrail: Discovery drafts source records only; it must not create forecasts or public read surfaces.

phases.purpose: Confirm or reject agent-inferred source roles, field mappings, and alias mappings.
phases.guardrail: Agent-inferred mappings remain proposals until deterministic validation or caller confirmation accepts them.

phases.purpose: Classify source manifests and mappings as usable, partial, confirmation-needed, or rejected.
phases.guardrail: Source intake may classify data, but it must not create forecast artifacts.

phases.purpose: Select the best justified enabled method for the accepted setup and preserve baseline fallback.
phases.guardrail: Method gates explain eligibility; they must not create forecast outputs.

phases.purpose: Create forecast artifacts only after source intake and method decisions allow execution.
phases.guardrail: Blocked execution outcomes must not bind forecast IDs, cards, bundles, or artifact paths.

phases.purpose: Append forecast updates when new pre-close evidence arrives without overwriting history.
phases.guardrail: Post-outcome evidence and resolution sources must not alter forecast-time probabilities.

phases.purpose: Resolve outcomes from declared resolution sources after the forecast closes.
phases.guardrail: Resolution sources may resolve outcomes but must not enter forecast-time evidence.

phases.purpose: Score resolved forecasts and update track-record and calibration summaries with sample-size boundaries.
phases.guardrail: Quality and calibration claims require enough comparable resolved outcomes.

outcomeClasses.agentInstruction: Continue through method gating, explicit forecast execution, resolution, and read surfaces.
Ask the caller to confirm proposed mappings before continuing.
Collect enough pre-close source rows or outcome evidence before retrying the phase.
Replace rejected sources before source intake, method gates, forecast execution, or scoring.
Use a supported fixture source or wait for a future connector runtime.
Do not simulate hosted upload, private API, or database behavior as implemented OPE support.

referenceImplementation.claimBoundary: The reference implementation is local fixture-safe and has one resolved source-handoff outcome, below quality and calibration claim thresholds.

guards.name: domain_agnostic_contract
guards.rule: The workflow must describe phases and outcomes without hard-coding weather-logistics as the product boundary.

guards.name: reference_wedge_boundary
guards.rule: Weather-logistics remains a reference fixture implementation, not proof of broad domain coverage.

guards.name: private_runtime_boundary
guards.rule: Manual uploads, private APIs, and databases are planned contract surfaces until a future runtime implements them.

guards.name: source_policy_boundary
guards.rule: Every setup path must declare source policy, mappings, provenance, and unavailable evidence before forecasting.

guards.name: blocked_outputs_boundary
guards.rule: Rejected, unsupported, unconfirmed, and runtime-not-implemented outcomes must not bind forecast or scoring outputs.

guards.name: claim_boundary
guards.rule: Setup-ready or scored fixture outcomes do not create calibration, production, or state-of-the-art claims.

warnings: This workflow is a domain-agnostic contract, not a hosted service runtime.
Manual uploads, private API setup, and private database setup are represented as planned contract surfaces, not implemented connectors.
The weather-logistics source-handoff runbook is the current fixture implementation, not a universal setup proof.
Quality and calibration claims remain tied to comparable resolved outcome counts.
